description: Let people be, stop trying to control others and learn to control yourself. You will make it to the other side. #selflove #criticalthinking #stewardship
transcript: I do not take anything personal because I understand duality. I understand nuance. I understand that we are all complex. I am always willing to readjust accordingly, but there are also exceptions that allow people to be who they are. I allow people to reveal themselves. I readjust and move accordingly.
